headline_stat.name: fraction of MEC units that are grid cells (gridness > pooled-shuffle 95th pct = 0.616)

stated_limitation: The session description text in every NWB file says the rat ran in a 1 x 1 m enclosure, but the tracked extent shows that 22 of the 118 sessions used a much larger, roughly 2 m circular arena. Spacing is therefore reported separately for the two groups... The NWB file does not record which of the two LEDs sits in front of the head, so a preferred head direction may be flipped by 180°... Finally, the grid-cell criterion is the pooled shuffle threshold used in the original literature; it is a population-level 5% false-positive rate, and 63% of the cells it selects also clear p < 0.01 against their own within-cell shuffle.

justification.dataset: DANDI:000582 (Sargolini MEC) is the canonical grid-cell dataset in the expected species, region, and free-foraging paradigm.
justification.handling: Real data streamed via remfile, speed-filtered, occupancy-normalized rate maps with spike positions from pynapple value_from, and explicit spike-count/rate inclusion criteria across all 620 units.
justification.analysis: Standard gridness (expanding-annulus min(r60,r120)−max(r30,r90,r150)) on Pearson autocorrelograms with a circular-shift shuffle null, split-half stability, and circular HD statistics with its own shuffle.
justification.correctness: Every headline number (193 grid cells, 49.6 cm spacing, 0.70/0.34 stability, 1.07 median gridness, 134 HD-tracked) reproduces from unit_metrics.csv to rounding and is internally consistent.
justification.figures: Figures clearly show hexagonal autocorrelograms, a bimodal observed-vs-shuffle distribution, and conjunctive tuning, with units labeled, and example cells honestly presented as 'highest-gridness' rather than as typical.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate to strong evidence and the write-up names the specific real weaknesses of this result (arena-size mislabeling, the population-level FPR nature of the threshold with a per-cell cross-check, and the HD 180° ambiguity).
justification.verdict: Sound, thorough, canonical demonstration whose numbers reproduce and whose limitations are disclosed; accept as-is.
